title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous
en:
Present Simple — habits, routines, facts, permanent situations: I work in risk management. She checks the reports every Monday. Negatives and questions: don't / doesn't, do / does.

Present Continuous (am / is / are + -ing) — now, around now, temporary: I'm preparing the audit file this week.

Time words: usually, every day, often, never → Simple; now, at the moment, this week, today → Continuous.

State verbs (know, like, want, need, understand, believe) — usually not continuous: I know, not I'm knowing.
ru: Present Simple — привычки, распорядок, факты, постоянное (he/she — окончание -s). Present Continuous — сейчас, в эти дни, временно (am/is/are + -ing). Глаголы состояния (know, like, want, need) — без -ing.

boss.situation: Describe your job: 3 sentences about what you usually do and 2 sentences about what you are working on this week.
samples: I work in the internal control department.
I usually check documents and test controls.
Every month I prepare a report for my manager.
This week I am preparing for an audit.
At the moment I am updating our risk matrix.

qs.q: My manager ___ to work by car every day.
qs.exp: Every day = routine → Present Simple; he → goes.

qs.q: Please be quiet. I ___ on the phone.
This week we ___ a new system.
She ___ coffee. She prefers tea.
I ___ what you mean.
___ you usually work on Saturdays?
Look! It ___.
Water ___ at 100 degrees.
“I am needing a new laptop” is correct.
qs.exp: need is a state verb: I need a new laptop.

qs.q: “He works from home today” can be correct, but “He is working from home today” is more natural for a temporary situation.
qs.exp: Today = temporary → Continuous is more natural.

qs.q: He ___ (not / like) long meetings.
a: doesn't like
does not like
qs.exp: State verb like, he → doesn't like.

qs.q: What ___ you doing at the moment? — I'm writing an email.
a: are
qs.exp: At the moment → are you doing.

qs.q: Our team ___ (meet) every Monday at nine.
a: meets

qs.q: I ___ (stay) with my parents until I find a flat.
a: am staying

qs.q: ___ your company have an office in Almaty?
a: Does

qs.q: Prices ___ (go) up these days.
a: are going

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: she usually checks the reports on friday
qs.exp: Adverb of frequency before the main verb.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: we are preparing for an audit this week

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: he does not work on sundays

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: what are you working on now
qs.exp: Continuous question, preposition at the end.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: how often do you travel for work

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
Correct the mistake: “She work in finance.”
a: She works in finance.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I am knowing the answer.”
a: I know the answer.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Do she speak English?”
a: Does she speak English?

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Look, the director come!”
a: Look, the director is coming!
Look! The director is coming!

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “He doesn't works on Fridays.”
a: He doesn't work on Fridays.
He does not work on Fridays.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I am usually start work at eight.”
a: I usually start work at eight.
qs.exp: Usual routine → Present Simple, no am.

qs.q: Я работаю в отделе внутреннего контроля.
a: I work in the internal control department.
I work in the department of internal control.
I work in internal control.

qs.q: Сейчас я готовлю отчёт.
a: I am preparing a report now.
I am preparing the report now.
Now I am preparing a report.
I am preparing a report at the moment.
I am writing a report now.

qs.q: Она не пьёт кофе.
a: She doesn't drink coffee.
She does not drink coffee.

qs.q: Мы встречаемся каждый понедельник.
a: We meet every Monday.
We have a meeting every Monday.
We have meetings every Monday.

qs.q: На этой неделе я работаю из дома.
a: This week I am working from home.
I am working from home this week.

qs.q: Я не понимаю этот вопрос.
a: I don't understand this question.
I do not understand this question.

qs.q: Что ты делаешь по выходным?
a: What do you do at the weekend?
What do you do at weekends?
What do you do on weekends?
What do you do on the weekend?

qs.q: Он сейчас разговаривает с директором.
a: He is talking to the director now.
He is talking with the director now.
He is speaking to the director now.
He is speaking with the director now.
Now he is talking to the director.
